text.p: Danish roadbuilder Phoenix Contractors said on Thursday that it was advising shareholders to accept Norwegian firm Rieber and Son's offer of 820 million Danish crowns ($127.3 million), the highest of three bids.

"The board of Phoenix Contractors learned today through the Stock Exchange that Superfos does not wish to increase its bid and therfore advises Phoenix shareholders to unite behind the offer from Rieber and Son," it said in a statement.
Rieber launched Denmark's first open takeover battle on January 15 and Superfos entered the bidding on January 30, followed by smaller Danish firm Marius Pedersen.

Rieber and Superfos last week each raised their bids, to 820 million crowns and 808 million respectively, while Pedersen effectively bowed out by saying that it would not increase its offer of 776 million crowns.
